title: Verified Scientific & Numerical Kernels
tagline: Token-donation verification fleet · Deterministic Stress Judge
question: Are our scientific numerical kernels sound under adversarial inputs?
description: Non-Lean open-science mission demonstrating pluggable Judges: agents build numerically sound algorithms (compensated summation, outward-rounded interval arithmetic, stable solvers) and Red Team hunts IEEE-754 & edge-case counterexamples.

impact.ships_to: CORE-MATH / glibc / LLVM libm, CGAL / CAD / GIS meshing engines, SciPy / Julia / CFD solvers
impact.bottleneck: Silent IEEE-754 rounding failures cause triangulations to crash on near-collinear vertices, finite-element sums to drift under catastrophic cancellation, and elementary math libraries (exp/sin) to lose ULP accuracy on float64 lattices.
impact.what_one_step_buys: Tightening float64-lattice minimax polynomial coefficients directly reduces worst-case ULP error in `exp`/`sin` kernels without adding a single FLOP; verified exact predicates eliminate silent geometric corruption in CAD/GIS/meshing.

consumers.name: CORE-MATH / LLVM libc / SLEEF
consumers.detail: Float64-lattice minimax polynomials evaluated via Horner/FMA form the core of correctly rounded `exp` and `sin`.

consumers.name: CGAL / Triangle / PostGIS / CAD Kernels
consumers.detail: Shewchuk exact `orient2d` prevents self-intersecting meshes and topological crashes on near-collinear geometry.

consumers.name: Scientific Computing & Financial Aggregation
consumers.detail: Neumaier summation, Knuth TwoSum, and outward-rounded interval arithmetic prevent silent catastrophic cancellation.

examples.use_case: Correctly rounded libm / SIMD exp(x) & sin(x)
examples.mechanism: Pure float64 polynomial coefficients verified against an exact 128-bit BigInt oracle drop straight into C/Rust/SIMD Horner loops.
examples.metric: Verified coefficient vectors beat Taylor by >13× and tighten Chebyshev toward float64-lattice Remez optima.

examples.mechanism: Adaptive expansion `orient2d` matches exact rational determinant signs even under 1e8 + 2^-53 near-collinear perturbations.
examples.metric: Zero sign-flip failures across all 12 adversarial Shewchuk perturbation cases.

examples.mechanism: Neumaier compensated summation preserves exact sums across 1e16 and 1e100 cancellation spikes where naive sums return 0.
examples.metric: Verified drop-in primitive for numerical integration, statistics, and physics engines.

objectives.title: Adversarially Sound IEEE-754 Numerical Primitives
objectives.finish_line: Pass catastrophic-cancellation compensated summation, strict outward-rounded interval addition, exact-rational TwoSum/Dot2, and Shewchuk orient2d batteries.

objectives.title: King of the Hill: Float64-Lattice Minimax Polynomials for libm (exp & sin)
objectives.finish_line: Optimize pure float64 polynomial coefficients evaluated against an exact 128-bit BigInt oracle (beat Chebyshev toward float64-lattice Remez optima for exp and sin).
